falsification_criteria: Cosine similarity remains below -0.2 after 500 additional training steps
Latent MSE fails to decrease by at least 15% on held-out validation trajectories
Training loss variance does not stabilize across consecutive epochs
hypotheses.mechanism: An excessively high learning rate prevents stable convergence on the dynamics manifold, causing the predictor to overshoot optimal weights and capture spurious inverse relationships. This manifests as consistently negative cosine similarity across horizons and monotonically increasing latent MSE.
hypotheses.statement: The dominant failure stems from optimization_instability, where the current learning rate induces gradient oscillations and divergence, leading to anti-correlated predictions and accumulating latent errors.
hypotheses.title: Optimization Instability from Excessive Learning Rate
